documents.text: Kansas City Southern Railway Depot (Many, Louisiana) The Kansas City Southern Railway Depot is a historic former Kansas City Southern Railway station located at 750 West Georgia Avenue in Many, Louisiana. The depot was built in 1929 to replace the original depot, which opened in 1896 when the railroad was completed through the town. The Spanish Colonial Revival building features arched parapets atop projecting walls and corner piers with curved decorative pieces on top. source_segments.text: Kansas City Southern Railway Depot (Many, Louisiana) The Kansas City Southern Railway Depot is a historic former Kansas City Southern Railway station located at 750 West Georgia Avenue in Many, Louisiana.
The depot was built in 1929 to replace the original depot, which opened in 1896 when the railroad was completed through the town.
The Spanish Colonial Revival building features arched parapets atop projecting walls and corner piers with curved decorative pieces on top.
Many's economy and municipal government were revitalized by the railway's completion, and the station brought both passengers and freight to and from the town.
